detail_totals.schedule: Governmental Funds Statement of Revenues and Other Financing Sources

notes: GAAP city. Governmental lines from Total Governmental Funds column (p4-5); business-type from Proprietary Funds Total column (p8-9). Trimmed PDF has 14 pages (manifest page numbers refer to the original). Governmental ending_cash = 'Cash (including cash equivalents)' line only (p3); cash held by County Treasurer 9,199.28 and CDs 701,539.07 are separate lines. 'Note Payment' (188,792.60) in the governmental other financing section is recorded in other_financing (negative) as printed; the p14 schedule shows the same amount as 'Debt Service and bond issue cost' within expenditures, recorded in detail as expenditure. Governmental statement lists expenditures by object, so functions are defaulted/guessed (review). Business-type disbursements are listed by object across mixed enterprise funds (electric, water, sewer, golf, trash, ambulance), defaulted to utilities where not obvious. Business-type reported receipts total is computed (operating revenue total + nonoperating revenues) as no single total printed. Business ending net position equals begin + receipts - disbursements + transfers net (-122,300). Balance sheet uses government-wide Statement of Net Position Totals column; 'Cash deficit - equity in pooled cash' 4,091,497.20 is a governmental liability as printed. Budget-and-actual all-funds schedule (p12) mixes fund types; only its business-type function lines (Public Safety - ambulance, Golf, Electric, Waste, Wastewater, Water; budgetary basis, no object breakdown) are recorded in detail, with no detail_totals entry since its totals mix fund types; its revenue, governmental function and debt service lines are not recorded; p13 revenue schedule (column labeled General but totals equal all governmental fund revenues incl. Street interest and grants) and p14 General Fund schedule of expenditures (columns General, Police, Street, Parks and Recreation, Cemetery, Library) were recorded as the detailed schedules. Read pages 1-14 of 14.
